_meta.model: Qwen3.6-27B (+ embedded MTP draft), quants: unsloth UD-GGUF Q6/Q8, AWQ-BF16-INT4, original Qwen3.6-27B-FP8
_meta.host: proxmox (docker via ssh); host NVML order 0=RTX3080(20GB) 1=RTX5090(32GB) 2=RTX3080(20GB); CONTAINER CUDA order is FASTEST_FIRST -> cuda:0=5090
_meta.harness: bench_measure.py --api openai (/v1/completions, usage fields, wall-clock tps); dk_cell/dk_launch/dk_measure/dk_down; KV_PARSE=vllm ('GPU KV cache size: N tokens' boot line)

metric_defs.prefill20k: P1: single request, 20000 exact unique input_ids (token-id-list prompt), max_tokens=1 -> prompt_tokens/wall (tok/s), AFTER a discarded full-size warmup prefill
metric_defs.decode1k_code: D1 CODE: single ~1000-token decode (max_tokens=1000, ignore_eos:true) -> completion_tokens/wall (tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_prefill: P8: 8 parallel x 6000 exact input_ids, max_tokens=1 -> total prompt_tokens / batch wall (aggregate tok/s)
metric_defs.par8_decode_code: D8 CODE: 8 parallel x ~400-token decode (ignore_eos) -> total completion_tokens / wall (aggregate tok/s)
metric_defs.maxKV_tokens: vLLM boot line 'GPU KV cache size: N tokens' at the cell's config (per MATRIX_READY: this IS the max-KV number, no bisection)

global_caveats: fp8 KV everywhere: --kv-cache-dtype fp8 in the base command of every cell (verified in boot config: kv_cache_dtype=fp8).

MTP/spec ACTIVE on every decode: --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'. The OpenAI /v1/completions surface does NOT expose spec accept length -> D*/accept = null; decode tok/s include the MTP speedup.
UNCACHED verified: unique-nonce token-id prompts; usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens == 0 on every request in every cell (uncached_ok=true, no llama.cpp-style field-semantics caveat).
tok/s are client wall-clock based (vLLM reports no server-side prefill/decode timings on this surface); one warmed battery per boot (no median-of-3).
3080 = SM86 Ampere: fp8 gemm emulated (marlin/W8A16 path) on the 3080 ranks of tp3auto/tp4 fp8 cells.

HARNESS/WRAPPER FIXES applied (M27b, all documented in-file): (1) shvllm_run.sh MODELPATH pointed at host-only path -> switched to VM-side models-cache (same class as M27a llamacpp F3; tokenizer for exact-length prefill loads on the VM). (2) bench_measure.py openai adapter now sends ignore_eos:true (a D1_prose stopped at comp=4 -> meaningless tps; vLLM sampling extra, mirrors M27a llamacpp fix). (3) bench_measure.py now issues a discarded full-size WARMUP-PREFILL before P1: the first request after boot pays a one-time lazy-compile (~60-90 s) and vLLM has no native prefill timing, so P1 was 4-5x too low (222 vs 1219 tok/s validated on fp8_tp3auto). (4) shvllm_run.sh tp4 used HOST-NVML indices for --rank-gpu-id; the fork resolves them in CONTAINER CUDA FASTEST_FIRST order (cuda:0=5090) -> old mapping co-located 2x14500 MiB on a 20480-MiB 3080 ('Physical impossibility' hard error, by design). Fixed to 0,0,1,2 (matches htsglang_dk_run.sh). (5) shvllm_run.sh made TOKVEC optional for tp3auto so the fork's 2-boot self-calibration (boot1 auto -> hint -> boot2 pinned) is usable.

MPS LESSON (critical): the documented check 'ls /tmp/nvidia-mps/' is a FALSE POSITIVE - stale sockets (Jul 10) survive daemon death. The daemon was NOT running; without it, co-located tp4 ranks only time-slice. Detected via 'echo get_default_active_thread_percentage | nvidia-cuda-mps-control' (-> 'Cannot find MPS control daemon process'). Restarted with CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/tmp/nvidia-mps nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d and VERIFIED live: nvidia-cuda-mps-server pid spawned, 5090 showed MPS server + BOTH rank processes. A first fp8_tp4 battery run without live MPS was DISCARDED. All tp4 numbers below are with verified-live MPS. Check liveness via control-daemon response, never via ls.

Thermal gate (cooldown.sh, <=80C) fired before EVERY boot (12 boots, temps 44-74C, all GO). Teardown to 0 MiB between cells (tp4 cells: 138 MiB residual = MPS server's own contexts, cleared when MPS was stopped at sign-off).

q8_tp3auto.cell: S4 TP=3 uneven auto, GGUF Q8 (UD-Q8_K_XL)

startup_args.attempted: same base as q6_tp3auto with --model .../Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q8_K_XL.gguf --tokenizer /models/unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-GGUF; --tensor-parallel-size 3 --rank-gpu-id 0,1,2 --rank-tp-ratio auto --rank-auto-reserve-mib 1500

notes: EXACT ERROR (worker load_model, all ranks): ValueError: Detected some but not all shards of language_model.model.layers.0.linear_attn.in_proj_qkvz are quantized. All shards of fused layers to have the same precision. (vllm_gguf_plugin/quantization/utils.py:34 is_layer_skipped_gguf, via MergedColumnParallelLinear for the GDN qkvz projection).

Root cause: unsloth UD-Q8_K_XL stores the fused in_proj_qkvz shards in MIXED precision (UD 'dynamic' quant keeps some sub-tensors unquantized/higher-precision); the image's GGUF-plugin fused-layer check rejects that. NOT an uneven-TP artifact: the even-split TP=4 cell fails with the IDENTICAL error at the same layer.

Q6 (UD-Q6_K_XL) loads fine in the same plugin -> Q8_K_XL-specific tensor layout. Fix would require patching vllm_gguf_plugin inside the image (out of measurement scope). 1 boot attempt (+1 for tp4), no fix attempts beyond diagnosis per discipline.
